name: Ghoulish Effigy
label: Quest
description: Abercrombie says the dead are pressing against his shack in Duskwood. He asks you to gather ghoul ribs for a grisly scarecrow meant to guard his home.

clips.title: The story
paras: Abercrombie says the dead are pressing against his shack in Duskwood. He asks you to gather ghoul ribs for a grisly scarecrow meant to guard his home.

Abercrombie lives beyond Darkshire's guarded bounds, alone among Duskwood's shadowed trees. Ghouls such as Flesh Eaters and Bone Chewers roam the wilds without restraint. He says ravenous corpses recently battered down his walls, and asks you for their ribs. He hopes a grisly effigy will keep the hungry dead away from his home.

Abercrombie trusts a grim plan over the Night Watch or stronger walls for his wooden shack. He believes an effigy made from ghoul remains will frighten off other scavenging dead. A scarecrow built from slain undead is unsettling, yet travelers in Duskwood often do as the hermit asks for needed coin.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I live so far from the protection of town, it's a wonder the ghouls and the walking dead haven't eaten me! In fact, just yesterday a pack of Bone Chewers was pounding on the walls of my house!
I want to make an effigy - a kind of "scarecrow" for Ghouls. To do that I need some Ghoul Ribs. You can get them from Flesh Eaters, Bone Chewers, Brain Eaters, Rotted Ones and Plague Spreaders.
Get the ribs for me, and I will repay you with some coin.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I think I hear a pack of Ghouls scurrying around the back of the house - I better put that effigy up quick! Did you get those Ghoul Ribs for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, thanks. These will do just the trick!
